name: Marsena
overview: Marsena is a male figure identified as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media, a position of significant authority and influence as noted in Esther 1:14. While his tribal affiliation and additional details are not recorded, his role as a prince highlights his prominence within the Persian and Median empire during the biblical period.
namesAndTitles: The name Marsena appears only once in Scripture, specifically in Esther 1:14, and no particular meaning or divine origin is attributed to it. Thus, the name is presented plainly without additional significance provided.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record any family relationships for Marsena beyond his status as one of the seven princes of Persia and Media. There are no further details about his relatives or personal connections.
scriptureSignificance: Marsena's significance lies in his role as one of the seven princes who served under King Ahasuerus in the Persian and Median empire. This position indicates his involvement in the governance and administration of the kingdom during a critical moment in the biblical narrative. His mention underscores the structured leadership present in the empire at the time of Esther.
